tools.name: get_dashboard_creation_workflow
tools.description: Start here for every DashLint dashboard task. Returns the orchestrated workflow (steps, guardrails, input handling) and a tool map listing which focused playbooks to call at each step.

tools.name: build_dashboard_blueprint
tools.description: Create a schema-aware implementation blueprint (v2.0) from locally profiled column metadata. Send only field names, inferred types, distinct counts, nullable percents, row count, and opt-in summary metrics (never dataset rows, samples, or identifiers). Returns single justified roles per field, additivity classes, default aggregations, grain detection, ratio recomputation formulas, local data checks, and askUser questions.

tools.name: get_dashboard_kit
tools.description: Primary dashboard assembly tool. Defaults to npm package instructions for npx dashlint-kit and runtime API docs. If npm is unavailable or package installation/commands fail, call again with mode 'inline' for the regular starter code, domain packs, and JS utilities. Inline output targets a 35 KB budget.

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Returns the DashLint MCP server and dashboard-kit version, supported features, and compatibility matrix.

tools.name: get_shell_preservation_spec
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use get_dashboard_kit instead. Returns the complete design system and shell contract derived from the Incident Pulse React dashboard.

tools.name: get_full_dashboard_template
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use get_dashboard_kit instead. Returns a lightweight HTML wireframe with ONLY the fixed application shell.

tools.name: get_component_patterns
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use get_dashboard_kit instead. Returns CSS, HTML snippets, and usage notes for specific dashboard components.

tools.name: get_js_utilities
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use get_dashboard_kit instead. Returns pre-wired JavaScript utilities for dashboard interactivity.

tools.name: get_data_insight_playbook
tools.description: Returns instructions for the AI assistant to inspect user-provided data locally, verify row grain/data quality, calculate defensible business insights, and communicate uncertainty.

tools.name: get_dashboard_composition_playbook
tools.description: Returns adaptive story structure, chart-selection guidance, and visual hierarchy principles. Dashboard body can vary by dataset; the application shell remains fixed.

tools.name: get_dashboard_interaction_playbook
tools.description: Returns concrete requirements for local CSV and Excel upload, live recalculation from each uploaded file, filters, chart selection/cross-filtering, detail drawers, responsive behavior, accessibility, and empty/error states.

tools.name: get_dashboard_completion_checklist
tools.description: Returns the final review checklist for data correctness, evidence, shell preservation, working interactions, responsive layout, and completion.
